All changes are strictly source-only and confined to the fresh directory [`_scratch/interrupted-owned-session-retirement-implementation01/`](file:///C:/Users/hello/AppData/Local/AgentControlRoom/worktrees/uoink-library/31e8890c-ab8/gemini/_scratch/interrupted-owned-session-retirement-implementation01). Candidate execution was zero (no imports, no compilation, no unit test runs, and no process spawning). Original proof files remain byte-identical.

---

### Implementation Seams & Architecture

1. **Manager-Owned Retirement Route ([`durable_lifecycle.py`](file:///C:/Users/hello/AppData/Local/AgentControlRoom/worktrees/uoink-library/31e8890c-ab8/gemini/_scratch/interrupted-owned-session-retirement-implementation01/durable_lifecycle.py))**:
   - Introduced [`_InterruptedRetirement`](file:///C:/Users/hello/AppData/Local/AgentControlRoom/worktrees/uoink-library/31e8890c-ab8/gemini/_scratch/interrupted-owned-session-retirement-implementation01/durable_lifecycle.py#L35-L48) to capture the exact manager, record, owner, token, service, gates, worker, permit, protection, gate, journal, raw bytes, head, revision, and delegate.
   - Implemented [`retire_and_reconcile_interrupted_owner`](file:///C:/Users/hello/AppData/Local/AgentControlRoom/worktrees/uoink-library/31e8890c-ab8/gemini/_scratch/interrupted-owned-session-retirement-implementation01/durable_lifecycle.py#L157-L278) (aliased as `reconcile_interrupted_owner`):
     - Validates manager and token lock ordering (`manager._lock` -> `token._lock`).
     - Verifies owner is in `Phase.QUARANTINED`, `_active == 0`, `_revoked is True`, `_closed_verified is False`, pipe pair is idle (`active is False`, `operations == []`), and all retained endpoint, worker, and member `HandleRecord` instances are confirmed.
     - Enforces collision exclusion against `_entering`, `_retired_recoveries`, and `_interrupted_retirements`.
     - Outside the manager lock, delegates to [`GeneratedLifecyclePort.retire_interrupted_worker`](file:///C:/Users/hello/AppData/Local/AgentControlRoom/worktrees/uoink-library/31e8890c-ab8/gemini/_scratch/interrupted-owned-session-retirement-implementation01/generated_adapter_flow.py#L396-L454) to observe process termination, verify job process count 0, and close handles individually.
     - Under manager lock, sets `owner._closed_verified = True`, `owner._closing = True`, and retires `record.protection = None`.
     - Calls `service.reconcile_live(token)` to append and flush the 5th frame (`CLEARED`), release the gate, and close the journal handle.
     - Validates the 5-frame sequence (`INITIALIZED -> RESERVED -> WORKER_BOUND -> QUARANTINED -> CLEARED`) and marks `record.phase = Phase.RELEASED`.

2. **Dedicated Journal Observers ([`generated_journal_setup.py`](file:///C:/Users/hello/AppData/Local/AgentControlRoom/worktrees/uoink-library/31e8890c-ab8/gemini/_scratch/interrupted-owned-session-retirement-implementation01/generated_journal_setup.py))**:
   - Added [`before_interrupted_close`](file:///C:/Users/hello/AppData/Local/AgentControlRoom/worktrees/uoink-library/31e8890c-ab8/gemini/_scratch/interrupted-owned-session-retirement-implementation01/generated_journal_setup.py#L125-L135) to validate journal handle closure via [`_InterruptedOperationProbe.before_interrupted_close`](file:///C:/Users/hello/AppData/Local/AgentControlRoom/worktrees/uoink-library/31e8890c-ab8/gemini/_scratch/interrupted-owned-session-retirement-implementation01/generated_adapter_flow.py#L247-L280).
   - Added [`complete_interrupted_recovery`](file:///C:/Users/hello/AppData/Local/AgentControlRoom/worktrees/uoink-library/31e8890c-ab8/gemini/_scratch/interrupted-owned-session-retirement-implementation01/generated_journal_setup.py#L175-L195) to assert 5 flushes, 5 confirmed frames, retained revocation on owner and token, and closed journal handle.

3. **Interrupted Port, Probe & Coordinator ([`generated_adapter_flow.py`](file:///C:/Users/hello/AppData/Local/AgentControlRoom/worktrees/uoink-library/31e8890c-ab8/gemini/_scratch/interrupted-owned-session-retirement-implementation01/generated_adapter_flow.py))**:
   - Added [`_InterruptedOperationProbe`](file:///C:/Users/hello/AppData/Local/AgentControlRoom/worktrees/uoink-library/31e8890c-ab8/gemini/_scratch/interrupted-owned-session-retirement-implementation01/generated_adapter_flow.py#L170-L280): raises `KeyboardInterrupt` in `next_segment` after the second segment exchange (`_next_index == 2`), observes 4-frame quarantine after adapter context unwinding, binds the service attempt, and validates 5-frame clearance before journal close.
   - Extended [`GeneratedLifecyclePort`](file:///C:/Users/hello/AppData/Local/AgentControlRoom/worktrees/uoink-library/31e8890c-ab8/gemini/_scratch/interrupted-owned-session-retirement-implementation01/generated_adapter_flow.py#L282-L460) with `_bind_interrupted_probe`, `next_segment` probe trigger, `retire_interrupted_worker`, and `_interrupted_retired`. Aggregate history flags (`pair.unconfirmed`, `worker.unconfirmed`, `read_set.unconfirmed`) remain `True` and are never reset.
   - Added [`InterruptedCleanupCoordinator`](file:///C:/Users/hello/AppData/Local/AgentControlRoom/worktrees/uoink-library/31e8890c-ab8/gemini/_scratch/interrupted-owned-session-retirement-implementation01/generated_adapter_flow.py#L710-L750) and [`controller_interrupted_recovery_flow`](file:///C:/Users/hello/AppData/Local/AgentControlRoom/worktrees/uoink-library/31e8890c-ab8/gemini/_scratch/interrupted-owned-session-retirement-implementation01/generated_adapter_flow.py#L752-L820) to coordinate quarantine validation, verify ordinary completion/reconciliation refusal, and execute interrupted retirement.

4. **Proposed Tests ([`test_interrupted_owner_retirement.py`](file:///C:/Users/hello/AppData/Local/AgentControlRoom/worktrees/uoink-library/31e8890c-ab8/gemini/_scratch/interrupted-owned-session-retirement-implementation01/test_interrupted_owner_retirement.py))**:
   - Created unexecuted tests covering the exact six contract cases:
     1. [`test_actual_adapter_interruption_preserves_error_and_quarantine`](file:///C:/Users/hello/AppData/Local/AgentControlRoom/worktrees/uoink-library/31e8890c-ab8/gemini/_scratch/interrupted-owned-session-retirement-implementation01/test_interrupted_owner_retirement.py#L141-L162)
     2. [`test_confirmed_idle_owner_retires_and_reconciles_once`](file:///C:/Users/hello/AppData/Local/AgentControlRoom/worktrees/uoink-library/31e8890c-ab8/gemini/_scratch/interrupted-owned-session-retirement-implementation01/test_interrupted_owner_retirement.py#L164-L192)
     3. [`test_foreign_stale_active_or_pending_attempt_refuses`](file:///C:/Users/hello/AppData/Local/AgentControlRoom/worktrees/uoink-library/31e8890c-ab8/gemini/_scratch/interrupted-owned-session-retirement-implementation01/test_interrupted_owner_retirement.py#L194-L241)
     4. [`test_retained_io_or_uncertain_handle_refuses_without_retirement`](file:///C:/Users/hello/AppData/Local/AgentControlRoom/worktrees/uoink-library/31e8890c-ab8/gemini/_scratch/interrupted-owned-session-retirement-implementation01/test_interrupted_owner_retirement.py#L243-L283)
     5. [`test_unobserved_exit_nonempty_job_or_close_failure_retains_custody`](file:///C:/Users/hello/AppData/Local/AgentControlRoom/worktrees/uoink-library/31e8890c-ab8/gemini/_scratch/interrupted-owned-session-retirement-implementation01/test_interrupted_owner_retirement.py#L285-L308)
     6. [`test_reentrant_or_clear_failure_preserves_first_error_and_gate`](file:///C:/Users/hello/AppData/Local/AgentControlRoom/worktrees/uoink-library/31e8890c-ab8/gemini/_scratch/interrupted-owned-session-retirement-implementation01/test_interrupted_owner_retirement.py#L310-L346)
